about.title: About Le Blanc & Moi
about.description: Independent civic and tourist application listing cultural, festive and sporting events within a 20 km radius of Le Blanc (Indre, France).
about.projectBody: Find cultural, sporting, festive and community events within 20 km of Le Blanc. Browse the list or map, filter by your interests and check practical details for each event. The site is available in six languages.
about.dataBody: The project’s data sources are DATAtourisme and OpenAgenda. Information is supplied by contributing organisations and event organisers. Check the event’s official website before travelling.
about.datatourismeLicense: Data under the Open Licence, with source attribution.
about.openagendaLicense: Public event listings may be reused under the applicable open licence.
about.photosBody: The photograph of Le Blanc on the home page is by Daniel Jolivet, under CC BY 2.0. Sources, licences and changes to local images are detailed in the credits document. Event images remain subject to their sources’ terms.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Le Blanc & Moi uses browser storage and the services needed to operate the site.

storage.title: Your language preference
storage.body: This site only uses your browser’s local storage (localStorage) to remember your language preference. This preference stays in your browser and is not used as a tracking identifier.
storage.delete: You can change the language at any time or delete this preference by clearing the site’s data in your browser settings. It remains stored until replaced or deleted.

tracking.title: No advertising tracking
tracking.body: The site does not implement advertising trackers or audience measurement tools. The publisher does not collect personal data for tracking or advertising purposes.

services.title: Technical services and external content
services.body: Cloudflare hosts the site and may process technical data, including your IP address, to deliver and secure the service. The map loads OpenStreetMap tiles; some event images also load from third-party servers. These providers receive the data needed for these requests, including your IP address, under their own privacy policies.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For questions about your data, contact Denis El Harch at the address below. If you send an email, your address and the information you provide will be used to handle your request.
